title: CherryBreeze
description: Speed boost in cherry grove biomes.
body:
# CherryBreeze

Speed boost in cherry grove biomes.

## Features
- Applies SPEED in specific biomes.
- Configurable intervals and amplifier.
- Permission-based access.
- Lightweight scheduled checks.

## Command
- `/cherrybreeze status | /cherrybreeze reload`

## Permissions
- `cherrybreeze.use`
- `cherrybreeze.admin`

## Config (snippet)
```yml
effect: "SPEED"
condition:
  type: "BIOME"
```

## Compatibility
- Server: Paper, Spigot, Purpur
- Minecraft: 1.16.5 - 1.21.4

## Install
1. Drop the jar into `plugins/`.
2. Restart the server.
3. Edit `config.yml` and run the reload command.
